definition: Varun Mohan is an American entrepreneur and software engineer.
details: Built GPU virtualization infrastructure (Exafunction) and pivoted to create Codeium and the Windsurf agentic IDE. He is the co-founder and former chief executive officer of Windsurf.

explainer.lead: Varun Mohan is an American software engineer who co-founded Codeium, the AI coding company behind the Windsurf editor, and joined Google DeepMind in 2025.
explainer.knownFor: Co-founding Codeium and leading it as CEO from free AI code autocomplete to the agentic Windsurf IDE.

contributions.name: Codeium
contributions.detail: Co-founded in 2021 with Douglas Chen; its free autocomplete and chat plugins brought AI coding help to dozens of editors.

contributions.name: Windsurf Editor
contributions.detail: Launched in November 2024: an AI-native IDE whose Cascade agent can plan and make multi-file changes.

contributions.name: Autonomy infrastructure at Nuro
contributions.detail: Before Codeium, led infrastructure for Nuro’s self-driving delivery vehicles.

contributions.name: Google DeepMind
contributions.detail: Joined Google DeepMind in July 2025 with Chen and part of the Windsurf research team to work on agentic coding.

timeline.what: Joins Nuro, later tech lead for autonomy infrastructure
